personality_one_liner: A dense, dark, tactical terminal interface optimized for rapid communication and deep grid immersion.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use solid dark surfaces with crisp borders
dont's: No blur or glass effects; keep the terminal aesthetic tactical and flat

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Entry point for grid credentials or offline avatar name.

states.error: Monospace red text indicating connection failure.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim (100% opacity at bottom). Input fields and 'Connect' button pinned to bottom third. Rajdhani for title, Space Mono for inputs.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: Primary communication hub with segmented sub-tabs for Local, IM, and Group.

states.empty: Terminal message: '> No local chat detected.'

screens.layout: Fixed top segment control (Local/IM/Group) with cyan active border. Dense list of chat bubbles (sharp corners, sm radius, Space Mono text with timestamps). Fixed compose bar at bottom with cyan send button.

screens.name: Friends
screens.purpose: View online/offline status and quick access to IM.

states.loading: Skeleton rows with subtle cyan pulse.
states.empty: '> Friends list empty. Add users to database.'

screens.layout: Dense flat list. Each row has a small status dot (neon green for online, muted for offline), avatar name, and a right-chevron to initiate IM. Divider lines between rows.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Hierarchical folder tree browser for user assets.
screens.layout: List layout with indentation indicating folder depth. Leading icons for asset types (box for Object, image for Texture, script-text for Script). Tap to expand/collapse folder.

screens.name: More
screens.purpose: Navigation hub for Settings, Radar, and Diagnostics.
screens.layout: Simple icon + label list rows. Violet accent used on navigation icons.

screens.name: Diagnostics
screens.purpose: Live view of grid connectivity, ping, and packet stats.
screens.layout: Dense 2-column grid. Monospace numeric readouts. Large latency gauge or colored text (Green < 100ms, Yellow > 100ms, Red > 300ms).

login_hero.alt: Abstract geometric pattern with glowing purple and green lines

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The prompt specifically overrides the ban on cyan/violet/navy. You MUST use the provided dark navy (#050810) and cyan (#00F0FF) / violet (#B026FF) accents for the cyberpunk aesthetic.
CRITICAL: Use 'Space Mono' for all chat bubbles, inputs, and diagnostic metrics. Use 'Rajdhani' for screen headers and tab labels.
CRITICAL: Implement the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top-to-bottom) on the Login screen behind the hero image. Ensure text and inputs contrast against the dark bottom 40%.
Keep borders sharp. Use radius_tokens.sm (4px) or md (8px) for inputs and chat bubbles. Do not use pill buttons unless explicitly required.
Chat bubbles should not be soft. Use surfaceSecondary for received messages and brandTertiary for sent messages, with sharp terminal-like corners.
In the Chat tab, build a custom segmented control for (Local, IM, Group). Do not use soft pills; use flat tabs with an active bottom border of brandPrimary.
For the Friends list, use MaterialCommunityIcons 'circle-slice-8' or similar for the online/offline presence indicator. Online = success color, Offline = muted color.
Inventory should use nested indentations (e.g., marginLeft based on depth) and distinct MaterialCommunityIcons for different item types (e.g., 'texture', 'cube-outline', 'tshirt-crew-outline').
Diagnostics screen must be extremely dense, mimicking a terminal monitor with stats and numbers aligned.
Do not implement glassmorphism or blur anywhere. This app uses solid dark surfaces with high-contrast text and dividers for a pure tactical utility feel.
Wire haptics to tab switches, send message, and expanding/collapsing inventory folders.
